verdict.rationale: Puzzle documents an embedded AI assistant that can be delegated bookkeeping tasks — 'Accounting AI' for importing PDFs/CSVs, 'AI Close' for month-end close, auto-categorization up to 98%, and natural-language Q&A ('How's my cash trending?'). This shows real task delegation to a built-in AI, but evidence is all first-party marketing/help-center copy with no independent hands-on account of how the assistant is invoked or its reliability. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of the assistant's task-delegation UX, detail on assistant scope/limits, and third-party corroboration beyond a single unrelated HN comment.
